1.consolidated_definition: ‘Hacer una conquista amorosa pasajera.’ “Anímate, quizá esta noche, en el baile, harás el levante de tu vida.”
1.en_consolidated_definition: To make a fleeting romantic conquest. "Encourage yourself, perhaps tonight at the dance, you will make the rise of your life."
